whisper-large-v3-turbo.pin_evidence: Official Hugging Face model repository HEAD observed 2026-10-12; separate pilot pin, EVAL-VOICE-V1 remains on large-v3.

normalization.wer: NFC; casefold Latin text; normalize Arabic/Persian digits to ASCII; ignore thousands separators between digits; replace Unicode punctuation with spaces; collapse whitespace; preserve script and Arabic combining marks.
normalization.cer: Codepoint Levenshtein over the same normalized text, including normalized spaces.
normalization.script_fidelity: Report detected Latin, Arabic, mixed, or unknown script separately; do not transliterate the primary reference automatically.
normalization.roman_urdu: Optional, separately human-verified Roman Urdu reference is scored in its own column; original reference remains unchanged.

commerce_evaluation.intent: Score retention of human-annotated intent cue spans; the ASR-only pilot has no intent classifier, so this is not intent classification accuracy.
commerce_evaluation.brands: Exact annotated brand-name mention preservation in the transcript.
commerce_evaluation.prices: Exact numeric amount extraction from spoken digit sequences; number-word conversion and currency classification are not claimed.

reporting.label: PILOT
reporting.error_examples: Include only when participant consent permits de-identified transcript examples and a human reviewer approves the specific example.
